mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_info (username, password, real_name, role, contact, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{role}, #{contact}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_info SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_info WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM user_info WHERE role = #{role} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
